name: WhatsApp Business
one_liner: WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) lets businesses send/receive WhatsApp messages, templates, and media programmatically via Meta's Graph API.
auto_notes: pass1/pass2 disagree on access (admin_approval vs self_serve_free)

evidence.quote: The temporary access token you created to send the hello_world template message expires quickly and is not suitable for development purposes.
Generate access token to send a test message
A list of publishing requirements are listed

probe.www_authenticate: OAuth "Facebook Platform" "invalid_request" "An active access token must be used to query information about the current user."

notes: Free Meta developer account + app gives an instant test phone number and temporary bearer token for sandbox testing (self-serve, no cost). Auth is Meta/Facebook OAuth2 flow producing bearer access tokens (temporary or permanent via System User); Graph API is REST-based. Scaling to production (beyond ~250 business-initiated conversations/24h to real customers) requires Meta Business Verification and app review of permissions (whatsapp_business_messaging, whatsapp_business_management), which is a lightweight but mandatory approval gate — hence yellow/app_review rather than pure green. No official Meta-published MCP server found; only community MCP implementations exist on GitHub. Composio wraps it with 57 tools via api_key/oauth2, consistent with REST + bearer/OAuth2 findings. API surface (messages, templates, media, phone numbers, business profile, flows, webhooks) is more than a handful of endpoints but not enormous — estimated medium breadth.
